LESSON: SIGN READING 7.2.2 COMPREHENSION

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.2: Sign Reading 7.2.2 Comprehension
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 7.2.2 Comprehension, part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three General.

Key inquiry question: what will happen in the text, 1. How do you identify the main idea in a text? 2. How do we relate titles and pictures to a story?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 7.2.2 Comprehension together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Creativity and imagination: The learner’s communication and self-expression skills are enriched as they make relevant predictions about a story based

on the title and pictures.

Values:
Unity: cooperation as the learner collaborates with others in group discussions.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills: Elevated self -esteem as the learner answers questions from a story correctly to show comprehension.

Link to other Learning Areas

Comprehension strategies is applicable in all learning areas.

Suggested Learning Resources

Assistive devices fitted with appropriate technology such as Hearing aids and amplifiers, charts showing words with the target letter sounds, flash cards

showing words with target letter sound, signed audio-visual recordings, print or digital stories, pocket charts, print and digital flash cards
